# AddTriangle

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces)

```blitzbasic
AddTriangle surface%, v0%, v1%, v2%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Joins three vertices of a surface into a triangle and returns the index of the triangle, which counts from 0. A triangle is only drawn when seen from the side where its corners go clockwise, which is why the order matters: if your triangle does not show, swap two of its vertices, or draw both sides with the 16 flag of [EntityFX](EntityFX). The runtime stops with an error for a vertex index that does not exist.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 0, -5
mesh = CreateMesh()
surf = CreateSurface(mesh)
a = AddVertex(surf, -2, -1, 0)
b = AddVertex(surf, -1, 1, 0)
c = AddVertex(surf, 0, -1, 0)
d = AddVertex(surf, 0.5, -1, 0)
e = AddVertex(surf, 1.5, 1, 0)
f = AddVertex(surf, 2.5, -1, 0)
; The left triangle goes clockwise as seen from the camera and is drawn.
AddTriangle surf, a, b, c
; The right one goes the other way around and is not.
AddTriangle surf, d, f, e
EntityFX mesh, 1
EntityColor mesh, 250, 200, 60
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![AddTriangle](media/blitz3d/addtriangle.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | Int | required | Surface handle. |
| `v0` | Int | required | Index of the first corner. |
| `v1` | Int | required | Index of the second corner. |
| `v2` | Int | required | Index of the third corner. |

**Returns:** The index of the new triangle, starting at 0.
